verification_scope: Official CDC index and codebook HTML only. No XPT request, participant record, or target endpoint analysis.

metadata_rules.weight: WTMEC2YR is the full-sample 2-year MEC examination weight. DEMO_J instructs use of 2-year weights for the 2017-2018 cycle. DXX_J instructs examination weights, although its paragraph contains a stale DXX_G identifier.
metadata_rules.design: SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU are masked variance pseudo-stratum and pseudo-PSU. PSU identifiers must be nested within strata.
metadata_rules.dxa_eligibility: DXA component eligibility is ages 8-59. Pregnancy, recent radiographic contrast, table weight and height limits are listed exclusions. The analysis deliberately uses the narrower frozen ages 20-59 and valid scans, with no inferred clinical exclusions.

dxa_scan_codes.2: Whole body scan completed but invalid
dxa_scan_codes.4: Not scanned: weight greater than 450 pounds
dxa_scan_codes.5: Not scanned: height greater than 6 feet 5 inches

metadata_rules.endpoint: DXDTOPF: total percent fat; use percentage points without calibration or trimming.
metadata_rules.bmi: BMXBMI: body mass index in kg/m^2.

preaccess_exposure_note: A web.find metadata request inadvertently returned adjacent published CDC frequency/completion table excerpts. No participant rows, DXDTOPF values, target endpoint associations, or computed target counts were acquired. Remaining HTML extraction suppressed frequency columns and selected variable definitions, category codes/descriptions, and XPT hyperlinks only. This is disclosed rather than characterized as zero aggregate metadata exposure.
